# active_learning/bayesian - diagnostician view

## smoke_bugs

```yaml
- id: AL-SB-labels-out-of-range
  symptom: Training raises ValueError/IndexError; y_train has values outside [0, n_classes-1].
  likely_cause: n_classes derived as len(y_pool.unique()) instead of int(y_pool.max())+1;
    under-sizes the model for sparse class indices.
  status: seed
- id: AL-SB-model-input-shape-mismatch
  symptom: forward() raises RuntimeError on wrong input rank/dim.
  likely_cause: Notebook reshapes/synthesizes data with a shape that disagrees with
    arch_contract.json's architecture.model.forward.input.
  status: seed
- id: AL-SB-stochastic-call-without-seed
  symptom: Reproducibility fails / smoke output non-deterministic across runs.
  likely_cause: np.random.choice / torch.rand in method.py with no rng derived from
    seed at function entry.
  status: seed
- id: AL-SB-forward-with-embedding-missing
  symptom: method.py calls model.forward_with_embedding(...) but the architecture
    never implemented it.
  likely_cause: architecture-coder omitted the penultimate-feature hook that BADGE-shaped
    batch acquisition requires.
  status: seed
- id: AL-SB-torch-tensor-from-tensor-list
  symptom: ValueError 'only one element tensors can be converted to Python scalars'
    at a torch.tensor([...]) call.
  likely_cause: torch.tensor([x_pool[i] for i in idx]) over a list of tensors; correct
    constructor is torch.stack/advanced indexing. Common in core-set construction.
  status: seed
```

## pluggable_component

```yaml
name: select_batch
return_type: List[int]
signature_template: select_batch(model, x_unlabeled, x_labeled, batch_size, seed,
  *paradigm_extras_by_name) -> List[int]
contract:
  fixed_positional_args:
  - model
  - x_unlabeled
  - x_labeled
  - batch_size
  seed_param: seed
  paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
  forbidden_param_names:
  - config
  - batch_output
  - batch_outputs
rationale: "Bayesian-AL methods are multi-step per acquisition round: they score\n\
  uncertainty (via MC dropout / posterior samples) but also reason about\ndiversity\
  \ or representativeness with respect to the already-labeled set\n(e.g., GBALD's\
  \ Eq. 13 computes distances to labeled-set penultimate\nfeatures). The pluggable\
  \ function therefore needs read access to\n`x_labeled` so it can implement what\
  \ the paper describes. Methods that\nonly need uncertainty (e.g., vanilla BALD)\
  \ accept the parameter and\nignore it; the cost of a one-extra-positional-arg is\
  \ small compared to\nthe cost of silently degrading multi-step methods to pure top-k.\n\
  \nStateless beyond the signature: the function must NOT mutate `x_labeled`\nor store\
  \ it \u2014 it's read-only state passed in by the notebook each round.\n"
```

## package_manifest

```yaml
description: Spec-derived structural contract for method/ files. Producer ownership
  is fixed by the pipeline; pluggable names/signatures and additional model methods
  come from method_spec.json.
files:
- path: method/data.py
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: package_scaffolder
  public_symbols:
  - name: load_data
    kind: function
    signature: 'load_data(path: str | os.PathLike | None = None, *, pool_size: int
      = 5000, n_test: int = 1000, seed: int = 0) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor,
      torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]'
- path: method/example_data/README.md
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: package_scaffolder
- path: method/model.py
  kind: paradigm_shaped
  produced_by: architecture_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: <ArchitectureClass>
    kind: class
    inherits: torch.nn.Module
    required_methods:
    - 'forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor'
- path: method/training.py
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: architecture_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: build_model
    kind: function
    signature: 'build_model(input_dim: int, n_classes: int, **arch_kwargs) -> <ArchitectureClass>'
  - name: train_from_scratch
    kind: function
    signature: 'train_from_scratch(model: <ArchitectureClass>, x_train: torch.Tensor,
      y_train: torch.Tensor, *, learning_rate: float, max_epochs: int, train_until_accuracy:
      float, seed: int) -> <ArchitectureClass>'
- path: method/method.py
  kind: method_shaped
  produced_by: method_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: select_batch
    kind: function
    signature: select_batch(model, x_unlabeled, x_labeled, batch_size, seed, *paradigm_extras_by_name)
      -> List[int]
    contract:
      fixed_positional_args:
      - model
      - x_unlabeled
      - x_labeled
      - batch_size
      seed_param: seed
      paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
      forbidden_param_names:
      - config
      - batch_output
      - batch_outputs
  - name: <method_helpers>
    kind: function
    all_top_level_functions_are_public: true
- path: method/__init__.py
  kind: derived
  produced_by: init_finalizer
  content_rule: 'Re-export every public symbol declared above. __all__ ordering: [pluggable_component.name,
    *method_helpers, *architecture_classes, *training_functions, load_data].'
- path: requirements.txt
  kind: derived
  produced_by: init_finalizer
  content_rule: Computed by AST-walking imports across method/ and notebook imports;
    base requirements are owned by finalize_package_init.py.
- path: method/README.md
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: package_scaffolder
dependency_graph:
  method/data.py: []
  method/model.py: []
  method/method.py:
  - method/model.py
  method/training.py:
  - method/model.py
  method/__init__.py:
  - method/data.py
  - method/method.py
  - method/model.py
  - method/training.py
validators:
  after_package_scaffolder: scripts/validate_scaffolder_output.py
  after_architecture_coder: scripts/validate_architecture_coder_output.py
  after_method_coder: scripts/validate_method_coder_output.py
  after_init_finalizer:
  - scripts/validate_package_imports.py
  - scripts/validate_arch_contract.py
  - scripts/validate_arch_contract_runtime.py
```

## arch_contract_requirements

```yaml
description: Spec-derived active-learning architecture contract requirements. Concrete
  shapes remain paper/code-derived; this only validates the universal AL contract
  surface.
required_blocks:
  data_loader.load_data_returns:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
    min_keys:
    - x_pool
    - y_pool
    - x_test
    - y_test
    exact_keys:
    - x_pool
    - y_pool
    - x_test
    - y_test
  architecture.model:
    required_subblocks:
    - class_name
    - forward.input
    - forward.output_type
  pluggable_component.name:
    must_equal: spec.comparison.pluggable_component.name
  pluggable_component.input_shapes:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
    min_keys:
    - x_unlabeled
  pluggable_component.output_shape:
    type: shape_string
  training_loop.function_name:
    must_equal: train_from_scratch
  training_loop.input_shapes:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
    min_keys:
    - x_train
    - y_train
symbol_conventions:
  B: runtime batch size inside model forward
  N: training-set size
  N_test: test-set size
  N_pool: unlabeled pool size
  n_features: input feature dim
  n_classes: number of classes
  hidden_dim: model hidden width when applicable
```
